one_liner: Indian markets declined amid global cues and FII outflows.

drivers.title: Global Cues
drivers.detail: Negative sentiment across global markets impacted indices.

drivers.title: FII Outflows
drivers.detail: FIIs were net sellers, offloading Rs 9,980.22 Cr.

drivers.title: Sectoral Losses
drivers.detail: IT and Auto sectors saw significant declines.

flows_line: FIIs sold Rs 9,980.22 Cr; DIIs bought Rs 6,952.71 Cr.
watch_next: Watch for German CPI and US GDP data tomorrow.
lesson_seeds: Global market sentiment can heavily influence local indices.
FII flows are critical for market direction.
Sectoral performances vary, impacting overall index movement.
Expiry days can add volatility to market sessions.
